WITH b AS (
SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code, e."EquipType" AS equipment_type, ls."lifeSupportStat" AS life_support_status,
 CASE om."OPER_status" WHEN 'Active' THEN 10*(1-om."OPER_hours"::numeric/NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs",0)::numeric) WHEN 'Standby' THEN 5*(1-om."OPER_hours"::numeric/NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs",0)::numeric) ELSE 0 END AS ors,
 CASE t."insulationStat" WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric/10 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric/10 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric/10 END AS tie,
 ls."O2SupplyStat" AS o2, ls."medEquipStat" AS med, ls."safetySysStat" AS saf
FROM "Equipment" e
JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.comm_link = c."COMM_ID"
JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Safety')
SELECT equipment_code, equipment_type, life_support_status, ROUND(0.7*ors + 0.3*tie, 2) AS lssr,
 CASE WHEN 0.7*ors + 0.3*tie >= 0.8 THEN 'High Reliability' WHEN 0.7*ors + 0.3*tie >= 0.6 THEN 'Moderate Reliability' WHEN 0.7*ors + 0.3*tie < 0.6 THEN 'Low Reliability' END AS reliability_classification,
 jsonb_build_object('oxygen_status', o2, 'medical_status', med, 'safety_system_status', saf) AS support_systems_status
FROM b
ORDER BY lssr DESC

WITH s AS (
SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE",
 (100 - w."structLoadPct"::numeric)/100.0 * CASE WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5 WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8 ELSE 1.0 END AS ssf,
 cab.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' AS heater, t."insulationStat" AS insul, ls."emerLightStat" AS emer
FROM "Equipment" e
LEFT JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" w ON w.opmaint_link = om."OP_MAINT_ID"
LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" cab ON cab."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.comm_link = c."COMM_ID"
LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Shelter')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS extreme_weather_ready_shelters
FROM s
WHERE ssf > 0.7 AND heater <> 'Off' AND insul <> 'Good' AND emer IN ('On', 'Testing')

SELECT cv."CHASSIS_ID" AS chassis_registry_id,
 (1 - ((cv.ground_vehicle_status->'brake_system'->>'pad_wear_pct')::numeric + (cv.ground_vehicle_status->'tracks'->>'wear_pct')::numeric)/200.0)
 * (split_part(cv.ground_vehicle_status->'vehicle_motion'->>'speed_kmh', ' ', 1)::numeric/50.0)
 * ((ef.engine_fluids_snapshot->'engine_core'->>'load_pct')::numeric/100.0) AS vpc
FROM "ChassisAndVehicle" cv
LEFT JOIN "EngineAndFluids" ef ON ef."ENGINE_ID" = cv.engine_link
note: vehicle_motion.speed_kmh strings carry an 'm/s' suffix but the numbers look like unconverted km/h values (all end in .x0, max 60.00); used the number as km/h without conversion.

SELECT om."OP_MAINT_ID" AS registry_id, om."OPER_hours" AS operation_hours, om."maintCycleHrs" AS maintenance_cycle_hours, om."OPER_status" AS operational_status,
 CASE WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10*(1 - om."OPER_hours"::numeric/om."maintCycleHrs"::numeric)
      WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5*(1 - om."OPER_hours"::numeric/om."maintCycleHrs"::numeric)
      ELSE 0 END AS ors
FROM "OperationMaintenance" om

WITH s AS (
SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code, e."EquipType" AS equipment_type,
 cab.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' AS heater_status, t."insulationStat" AS insulation_status, ls."emerLightStat" AS emergency_light_status,
 (100 - w."structLoadPct"::numeric)/100.0 * CASE WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5 WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8 ELSE 1.0 END AS ssf
FROM "Equipment" e
JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" w ON w.opmaint_link = om."OP_MAINT_ID"
LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" cab ON cab."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.comm_link = c."COMM_ID"
LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE")
SELECT equipment_code, equipment_type, heater_status, insulation_status, emergency_light_status, ROUND(ssf, 2) AS structural_safety_factor,
 CASE WHEN ssf > 0.7 AND heater_status <> 'Off' AND insulation_status <> 'Poor' AND emergency_light_status IN ('On', 'Testing') THEN 'Extreme Weather Ready' ELSE 'Not Ready' END AS extreme_weather_readiness_status
FROM s
note: Used the EWR definition (insulation status not 'Poor'); the separate EWRS entry says insulation != 'Good', which would flip one row (PE162064). Returned all equipment with weather data plus a status column rather than filtering to Ready.

WITH b AS (
SELECT c.loc_link AS station_name, c."equipRef" AS equipment_code,
 CASE c.antenna_stat WHEN 'Error' THEN 0 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5 WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END * (1 - c."netLatency_ms"::numeric/1000) AS cri,
 c."radioSignal_dBm"::numeric AS radio, c."netLatency_ms"::numeric AS lat
FROM "Communication" c
WHERE c.antenna_stat IS NOT NULL AND c."netLatency_ms" IS NOT NULL AND c."radioSignal_dBm" IS NOT NULL),
m AS (SELECT *, cri * (1 + 0.2*radio/100) * (1 - 0.01*(1000 - lat)) AS bscsi FROM b),
st AS (SELECT station_name, AVG(cri) AS avg_cri, AVG(bscsi) AS avg_bscsi, string_agg(equipment_code, ', ' ORDER BY equipment_code) AS equipment_list FROM m GROUP BY station_name)
SELECT station_name, ROUND(avg_cri, 2) AS avg_cri, ROUND(avg_bscsi, 2) AS avg_bscsi, equipment_list
FROM st
WHERE NOT (avg_cri > 0.8 AND avg_bscsi > 0.85) AND NOT (avg_cri > 0.6 AND avg_bscsi > 0.7)
ORDER BY avg_bscsi ASC

WITH b AS (
SELECT l."locType" AS location_type, l."STATION_name" AS station_name, c."equipRef" AS equipment_code,
 (t."solarOutput_w"::numeric + t."windOutput_w"::numeric) / NULLIF(t."fuelCellOutput_w"::numeric + t."solarOutput_w"::numeric + t."windOutput_w"::numeric, 0) * 100 AS rec,
 t."solarOutput_w"::numeric + t."windOutput_w"::numeric AS renewable_w
FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t
JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = t.comm_link
JOIN "Location" l ON l."STATION_name" = c.loc_link
WHERE t."solarOutput_w" IS NOT NULL OR t."windOutput_w" IS NOT NULL)
SELECT location_type, station_name, COUNT(equipment_code) AS equipment_count, ROUND(AVG(rec), 2) AS rec, SUM(renewable_w) AS total_renewable_output_w,
 CASE WHEN AVG(rec) > 70 THEN 'Energy-Sustainable' WHEN AVG(rec) > 50 THEN 'Moderately Sustainable' ELSE 'Low Sustainability' END AS sustainability_classification
FROM b
GROUP BY location_type, station_name
ORDER BY rec DESC
note: Aggregated per station (avg of per-equipment REC); wind output NULL for some rows so those RECs are NULL and excluded from the average.

WITH b AS (
SELECT e."EquipType" AS equipment_type, e."EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code,
 ((et.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric)/2 * (1 - (et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric/100) AS eer,
 (et.type_indices->>'safety_idx')::numeric AS safety_index
FROM "Equipment" e JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON et."EquipType" = e."EquipType"),
r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_type ORDER BY eer DESC) AS efficiency_rank,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_type ORDER BY safety_index DESC) AS safety_rank FROM b)
SELECT equipment_type, equipment_code, ROUND(eer, 2) AS eer, safety_index, efficiency_rank, safety_rank, ABS(efficiency_rank - safety_rank) AS rank_difference
FROM r
ORDER BY equipment_type, eer DESC

SELECT l."STATION_name" AS station_name, w."waterQualityIdx" AS water_quality_index, w."waterLevelPct" AS water_level_percent,
 CASE WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 THEN 'Good' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 26 THEN 'Poor' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" < 26 THEN 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification
FROM "Location" l
LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c.loc_link = l."STATION_name"
LEFT JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = c."equipRef"
ORDER BY l."STATION_name"

WITH b AS (
SELECT l."STATION_name" AS station_name, l."locType" AS location_type, w."waterQualityIdx"::numeric AS wqi,
 (w."waterLevelPct"::numeric/100) * (w."waterQualityIdx"::numeric/100) * (1 - w."wasteTankPct"::numeric/100) AS wrmi
FROM "WaterAndWaste" w
JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = w."equipRef"
JOIN "Location" l ON l."STATION_name" = c.loc_link)
SELECT station_name, location_type, ROUND(AVG(wqi), 2) AS avg_water_quality_index, ROUND(AVG(wrmi), 2) AS avg_wrmi,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wrmi < 0.5) AS conservation_needed_count,
 CASE WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality' WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 71 THEN 'Good' WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 51 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 26 THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification,
 CASE WHEN AVG(wrmi) < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed' WHEN AVG(wrmi) < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised' ELSE 'Sustainable Management' END AS water_management_status
FROM b
GROUP BY station_name, location_type
ORDER BY avg_wrmi DESC, avg_water_quality_index DESC
